info.description: The shipped public developer API. Base URL is the developer-api edge function. Auth is an API key (bmp_live_… / bmp_test_…) in the X-Api-Key header. Keys are created in the app (Business settings or the API page); only the SHA-256 hash is stored and the full key is shown once. TEST KEYS ARE READ-ONLY: this app has no test-mode ledger, so a test key can never move real money. Write attempts with a test key return 403 test_mode_read_only. Not available via the API (dark rails, documented honestly): MoonPay, Stripe, Payoneer partner API, and virtual-card issuing to third parties.
info.title: BMaGlass Pay Developer API

get.description: Scope: bitcoin:read. Returns crypto_wallets rows (balance_sats / available_sats).
Scope: bitcoin:read. Returns the address already issued to the account in the app. The API does not derive addresses: if none exists this returns 404 no_deposit_address.

post.description: Scope: bitcoin:read. Creates a price-locked quote using the same live price sources and 1.5% (150 bps) fee as the app's btc-trade function. Quote only — execution happens in the app, not via the API. Test keys may create quotes (no money moves).
Scope: payment_links:write. LIVE KEYS ONLY. Emits payment_link.created to registered webhooks.
post.summary: Create a payment link (live keys only)

post.description: Scope: transfers:write. LIVE KEYS ONLY — test keys get 403 test_mode_read_only. Charges the standard 1.5% transfer fee on top via execute_transfer_with_fee, exactly like the app. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe. Emits transaction.completed to registered webhooks.
post.summary: Send a wallet-to-wallet transfer (live keys only)

post.description: HTTPS URLs only. The signing secret (whsec_…) is returned exactly once in this response. Events: transaction.completed, payment_link.created, webhook.test. Allowed with test keys (no money moves).
